source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("e-participation" OR eParticipation OR "digital participation") AND (city OR urban OR planning)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("e-participation" OR eParticipation OR "digital participation") AND (city OR urban OR planning),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("digital participation" OR "e-participation" OR "eParticipation") AND ("city" OR "planning" OR "urban"))
